summary: The diff adds a new TechifyLandingPage React page with Tailwind styling utilities, centralized constants for phone/UPI, and helper functions for UPI + WhatsApp links, plus a DEPLOYMENT.md. Some acceptance criteria cannot be fully verified due to truncation, and the WhatsApp wa.me link formatting appears incorrect (includes a leading '+').

missing_requirements.requirement: WhatsApp Support link must point to a wa.me URL using phone number 9622655116 with appropriate country code formatting (digits-only path).
missing_requirements.reason: The generated WhatsApp URL uses an E.164 string with a leading '+' ("+919622655116"), producing `https://wa.me/+919622655116?...`, but wa.me expects the phone number path segment to contain only digits (no '+').

missing_requirements.requirement: Phone number 9622655116 is visibly displayed on the page with a clickable tel: link.
missing_requirements.reason: The landing page file is truncated; the provided diff excerpt does not show any visible phone number text or a `tel:` anchor in the rendered JSX, so this cannot be confirmed from the diff summary evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: UPI ID 9622655116@ybl is visible on the page as selectable/copyable text.
missing_requirements.reason: Although the UPI ID is defined in constants and used to generate a UPI deep link, the landing page JSX is truncated and does not show the UPI ID being rendered as visible text anywhere.

missing_requirements.requirement: Both CTA buttons (desktop “GET INSTANT ACCESS” and mobile bottom CTA) must open the UPI deep link and no occurrences of placeholder "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" remain.
missing_requirements.reason: A UPI deep link generator exists, but the CTA button/link implementations are not visible in the truncated landing page file, so it cannot be verified that both CTAs use the generated link or that "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" is removed everywhere.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/implemented Internet Identity + React Query actor plumbing (useActor/useInternetIdentity/main.tsx wrapping) despite the landing page being described as a static marketing page with no login required.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on a public single-page landing page and explicitly says no login required; adding identity context + actor/query invalidation logic is not requested as part of the landing page requirements.
